notes.title: TRAPPED FORCED TO KILL DEMO
notes.content:
[b][u]HUGE UPDATE FOR MY DEMO!![/u][/b] ːsteamhappyː

- Fixed up some sprites
-Added much more detailed drawings
-Fixed writing to make it more readable
- Game now includes about 30 more minutes of gameplay
- The game now has a FULL character introduction. So, you can get to know and ask all the characters questions for free!
-Includes a major twist at the end
-Added a credit scene at the end
-Added more music and sound effects
-Fixed some bugs (still some more to fix)
-Made changes to the storyline
-Added a new character!
